[quote=pantagruel;60853166][b]On the concern of Empire Island[/b]

The United Federation expresses deep concern regarding Balion's illegal imposition of control over Empire Island, which resides within Kianzhou therefore constituting a violation of the Thawne Doctrine. Such conduct is unacceptable as the Thawne Doctrine acts as a legal force deterring foreign powers from influencing or gaining monopoly upon the continent, and exceptions may trigger a theorized "domino effect" which could proliferate malicious foreign interests within the continent. Therefore, Daesun wishes to expel Balion from the continent as soon as possible while also minimizing the need for military conflict.

Thus, Daesun demands Balions immediate withdrawal from Empire Island and its subsequent transfer to TCP jurisdiction. To ensure legal justification and rationality, Daesun invites Balion to dispatch a representative to the capital of Teremok to discuss the future of Empire Island with Daesun and other TCP members. If Balion rejects this offer, or nothing is made of the attempted dialogue, Daesun pledges to take military action to expel Balion from the continent.
